create_basis_direction: create a BasisDirection with a name and optional value for one-hot encoding
build_vector_in_basis: build a VectorInBasis from basis directions and numpy magnitudes array
create_vector_space_with_basis: create a VectorSpaceWithBasis from a sequence of BasisDirection objects
compute_direct_sum: compute the direct sum of multiple VectorSpaceWithBasis objects
project_vector: project a VectorInBasis onto another basis or VectorSpaceWithBasis
